en.title: Kentucky Secures $18.8 Million to Boost Disability Accessibility and Safety Projects
en.summary: Kentucky Governor Andy Beshear announced over $18.8 million in funding for accessibility and safety improvement projects across the state. The investment aims to upgrade infrastructure such as transit, sidewalks, and public facilities to better serve people with disabilities. Additional highlights include a Kaohsiung report revealing over 10,000 missing accessibility items and new research on AI's role in improving digital accessibility.

zh-TW.title: 肯塔基州獲1880萬美元提升殘障無障礙與安全設施
zh-TW.summary: 肯塔基州州長安迪·貝謝爾宣布撥款超過1880萬美元，用於全州範圍內的無障礙與安全改善項目。投資將用於改善大眾運輸、人行道和公共設施，以提升殘障人士的可及性。其他重點包括高雄市公共無障礙設施缺失超過一萬項的報告，以及探討人工智慧如何提升數位無障礙的研究。
